usage.headings: Nunito (Weights: 700, 800) - Use for Logo, Section Headers, Big Buttons
usage.body: Outfit (Weights: 400, 500) - Use for Menu items, descriptions, standard text

Navigation.interaction: Bouncy hover effects (scale-105), Active state has 'pop' color

NavItem.base_classes: flex items-center gap-4 px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl transition-all duration-200 font-bold text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900

Logo.style: text-2xl font-extrabold text-purple-600 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2

UserMenu.style: Floating card at bottom of sidebar (desktop) or top right (mobile)

instructions_to_main_agent: REPLACE the top navbar in Navigation.jsx with a responsive Sidebar (Desktop) / Bottom Bar (Mobile) layout.
USE the 'Nunito' font for all headings and navigation text to make it friendly.
IMPLEMENT a '3D Button' look for active states using borders (e.g., border-b-4).
GROUP navigation items by role (Student, Teacher, Parent) clearly.
USE large, colorful icons for each menu item.
ENSURE the 'Features' dropdown is converted into an expandable accordion or a separate section in the sidebar.
KEEP all existing routes and logic (isTeacher, isStudent, etc.).
ADD a 'Gamified' feel: Progress bars or streaks in the sidebar if data allows (mock it if needed).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it is a very large headline.
Avoid thin borders (1px). Use 2px or 3px for a 'cartoon' feel.
Use 'gap-4' or 'gap-6' minimum. Don't cram elements.
